notify.notifications.title: Notifications
notify.notifications.description: Tell your team in Telegram, Slack, Mattermost or Rocket.Chat when components are published, updated or deleted
notify.notifications.emptyText: Add a Telegram chat or an incoming webhook of Slack, Mattermost or Rocket.Chat to hear about changes in your repositories.
notify.notifications.deleteText: Delete the channel {name}? No more notifications will be sent to it.
notify.notifications.saveError: The channel could not be saved
notify.notifications.testFailure: The test message was not delivered
notify.notifications.testDelivered: The test message was delivered. Check the chat.
notify.notifications.name: Name
notify.notifications.telegramHelp.title: How to connect a Telegram chat
notify.notifications.telegramHelp.bot: Create a bot with {link} and copy the token it gives you.
notify.notifications.telegramHelp.chat: Add the bot to a group or a channel. In a channel, make it an administrator allowed to post messages.
notify.notifications.telegramHelp.id: Send any message to the chat, open {url} and copy the value of {field}. Group and channel IDs start with -100.
notify.notifications.slackHelp.title: How to connect Slack, Mattermost or Rocket.Chat
notify.notifications.slackHelp.webhook: In Slack, create an app with incoming webhooks and add a webhook for the channel. In Mattermost or Rocket.Chat, create an incoming webhook in the integration settings.
notify.notifications.slackHelp.url: Paste the webhook URL here. Messages use Slack markup, which Mattermost and Rocket.Chat understand too.
notify.notifications.webhookHelp.title: How to receive notifications in your own service
notify.notifications.webhookHelp.endpoin: Create an endpoint that takes POST requests with a JSON body and answers with a 2xx status. Requests answered with 429 or 5xx are sent again, after Retry-After when it is given.
notify.notifications.webhookHelp.headers: Each component change comes in its own request with the headers {event} ({published}, {updated}, {deleted} or {test}) and {delivery}, an identifier that stays the same when a delivery is repeated.
notify.notifications.webhookHelp.signatu: When a signing secret is set, check {header}: {prefix} followed by the hexadecimal HMAC-SHA256 of the raw request body.
notify.notifications.emailHelp.title: How email notifications work
notify.notifications.emailHelp.server: Messages go out through the email server set up under System → Email.
notify.notifications.emailHelp.recipient: List the addresses that should receive them, separated by commas.
notify.notifications.webhookHelpText: Kept secret: the list shows only the host
notify.notifications.secretSaved: Saved. Leave the field empty to keep it.
notify.notifications.savedSecretRemoved: The saved value will be removed when the channel is saved.
notify.notifications.chatIdHelp: A number such as -1001234567890, or @name of a public channel
notify.notifications.threadHelp: Optional: the topic of a forum group to post in
notify.notifications.signingSecretHelp: Optional: every request body is signed with HMAC-SHA256 in the {header} header
notify.notifications.authorizationHelp: Optional: sent in the {header} header, for example {example}
notify.notifications.connectionHelp.glob: The proxy, timeouts and User-Agent of System → HTTP apply.
notify.notifications.connectionHelp.none: Messages go straight to the service, past the proxy of the HTTP settings.
notify.notifications.connectionHelp.cust: For a service reachable only through a proxy. An HTTP proxy carries HTTPS through CONNECT; SOCKS5 resolves names on the proxy side.
notify.notifications.proxyCredentialsHel: Optional: only for a proxy that asks for them
notify.notifications.eventHelp.published: A new component appeared in the repository
notify.notifications.eventHelp.updated: Files were uploaded again into an existing component
notify.notifications.eventHelp.deleted: The component was deleted by hand or by a cleanup policy
notify.notifications.repositoriesHelp: Leave all unchecked to follow every hosted repository.
notify.notifications.errors.name: Enter a name
notify.notifications.errors.recipients: Enter at least one email address
notify.notifications.errors.authorizatio: Enter the header value as one line of ASCII characters
notify.notifications.errors.proxyHostFor: Enter a host name or an IP address without a scheme or port
notify.notifications.errors.proxyUsernam: Enter the username for this password
notify.capabilities.title: Capabilities
notify.capabilities.description: Manage the capabilities and plugins of the repository manager
notify.capabilities.aboutText: Capabilities are optional features of Astrum Repository. Turn them on and off as needed; some of them need settings.
notify.capabilities.deleteText: The capability and its settings will be removed for good. This cannot be undone.
notify.capabilities.saveFailed: The capability could not be saved
notify.capabilities.errors.url: Enter a URL such as https://repo.example.com
notify.nodes.title: Nodes
notify.nodes.description: The nodes of this Astrum Repository instance
notify.nodes.single: This instance runs as a single node; no other replicas have reported to the database. Read more in the {link}.

notify.nodes.replicas.one: {count} replica of this instance shares the database and reports to it.
notify.nodes.replicas.other: {count} replicas of this instance share the database and report to it.

notify.nodes.participating: Nodes that belong to this Astrum Repository instance.
notify.nodes.name: Node Name
notify.nodes.currentHint: The node you are connected to
